conceptual assets.information: The DMI error status records that a DMI request was attempted while the controller was busy and is returned in DMI scan readback. Debug software depends on it to distinguish a rejected or invalid transfer.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity is at risk because the error status is cleared or set by the busy, reset and trigger conditions at lines 256-259, then returned through the DMI scan value at lines 229 and 209; an incorrect status can make software treat a failed transfer as successful or vice versa.

clk_i and rstn_i only time or reset the unit at lines 27-28 and are excluded clock and reset information.

The bypass register only forwards JTAG scan data through lines 197 and 210 and the RTL shows no protected information or security objective attached to it.
